the_rule.statement: Before a candidate estimand may enter a pre-registration, its value under a PURELY DESTRUCTIVE patch must be computed from CLEAN RUNS ALONE, and its distribution and its fraction at or below zero must be reported. A candidate that is not approximately zero under pure destruction may not be registered.
the_rule.cost: no GPU work and no patched data; clean forwards are sufficient
the_rule.on_failure: the candidate is out. It is not repaired to make it pass

how_the_substitution_is_made.principle: a state that has been destroyed carries no information about which answer token is which, so the model's output distribution at that position tends toward one that does not distinguish them
how_the_substitution_is_made.operationally: substitute the destroyed run's statistics into the candidate's formula and evaluate it against the clean donor and clean recipient runs, sweeping over the observed range of clean-run values
how_the_substitution_is_made.what_makes_it_cheap: both clean runs already exist for every unit; nothing has to be patched to learn what a destructive patch would do to the formula

it_killed_an_entire_family_before_any_me.family: difference-ratio estimands of the form (L_patch - L_clean) / (L_full - L_clean)
it_killed_an_entire_family_before_any_me.mechanism: in its own clean run the recipient PREFERS its own answer, so logit(a_R) starts high and logit(a_D) starts low. Destruction drags the high one down far more than the low one, so the difference RISES
it_killed_an_entire_family_before_any_me.sweep: 20000 clean-run pairs, using no measured data: mean 0.4997, fraction at or below zero 0.0000
it_killed_an_entire_family_before_any_me.it_predicted_the_failure_before_it_was_o: synthetic case 2 subsequently measured 0.515487, and P-0's random-donor null had measured 0.4139

it_also_kills_the_next_obvious_candidate.candidate: the rise in the donor answer's own log-probability
it_also_kills_the_next_obvious_candidate.mechanism: a_D is a LOW-probability token in the recipient's clean run, and destruction FLATTENS the distribution; flattening necessarily raises low-probability tokens, so the numerator is positive under pure destruction
it_also_kills_the_next_obvious_candidate.relation_to_the_first: the mirror image of the same mechanism, which is why two natural forms both died

why_it_exists.the_general_lesson_recorded: no functional form may be assumed safe before it passes this sweep; intuition about which quantities are 'obviously' destruction-immune has now failed twice

relation_to_OD_011.OD-011_rev_2_remains_in_force: a non-vacuity demonstration must include a must-return-negative case AND a must-return-positive case
relation_to_OD_011.how_they_differ: OD-011 tests the DECISION RULE on synthetic curves; OD-022 tests the ESTIMAND itself against a specific adversary, using only clean runs
relation_to_OD_011.ordering: OD-022 first, because a candidate it rejects never needs an OD-011 demonstration

what_it_does_not_do: it does not certify that a surviving candidate is correct; it only removes candidates known to be broken
it does not replace a positive control on a known-positive object
it does not licence registering a candidate that survives it but fails OD-011
claim_ceiling: A governance rule. It licenses no claim of any kind.
